name: Hindu Push-Up
research: Hands planted at world (+-0.22, -0.40, 0.04); balls of the feet planted at y ~0.88, x +-0.20. Straight arm shoulder->hand 0.60. START (inverted V): trunk and arms in one line: trunk up-vector (0,-0.712,-0.702) -> root rot X 134.6; arms elev 177 / plane 90 (in line, 3 deg toward the chest side). Shoulder offset rotated (y -0.281, z -0.383) and hand = shoulder + 0.597 along the arm -> root (0,0.285,0.864); hip L (0.11,0.318,0.826). Feet on the balls, heels toward the floor (rot X 45: ball 0.047 ahead of / 0.151 under the ankle) -> ankle (0.20,0.927,0.159); hip-ankle 0.908 = straight legs; hip angle ~80 deg. END (arched): pelvis rot X 62, spine -8/-8/-7/-6/-5 = -34 deg arch; the shoulder-neck chord of the torso sits ~17 deg higher (~45 deg head-up), so arms vertical under the shoulders = elev 45, plane 90. Shoulder (0.22,-0.40,0.64) over the hand -> root = shoulder - Rx(45)*(0.22,-0.076,0.469) = (0,-0.015,0.362); hip L (0.11,-0.041,0.318) (pelvis skin ~0.2 m up, off the floor). On the toes (rot X 75: ball 0.035 behind / 0.154 under the ankle) -> ankle (0.20,0.845,0.162); hip-ankle 0.904 = straight legs. Neck -8 / head -8 = looking ahead. The torso-chord approximation for the arched pose must be checked with measure_pose (hands at z 0.02-0.05). skin options copied from the approved overhead shoulder press for the V. Sources S1 Wikipedia (Hindu push-up), S2 Intziegianni 2026 (push-up EMG).
